tools.name: check_permission
tools.description: Agent permission gate. Exit 0 allow, 2 ask once, 1 deny. Covers commit, push, PR, merge, release, and dev/staging/prod reads and writes from the agent preset in .heyeddi/stack.json.

command.description: Shell command the agent is about to run

approved.description: The user said yes to this action in the current turn

tools.name: classify_command
tools.description: Internal classifier behind check_permission. Exit 1 marks a live infrastructure write; check_permission decides whether it may run. Plan exits 0 and must be summarized.
